verses.sloka: जनकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ।धनुर् दर्शय रामाय इति ह उवाच पार्थिवम् ॥१-६७-१॥
verses.transliteration: janakasya vacaḥ śrutvā viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ।dhanur darśaya rāmāya iti ha uvāca pārthivam ॥1-67-1॥

translations.english: At the words of Janaka, great ascetic Viswamitra said to the king, "Let the bow be shown to Rama".
translations.hindi: Q त्रिषष्टितमः सग : —:0:— पूण © ७. [oe ण बसहस्ले तु त्रतस्नातं ^ महामुनिम्‌ । अभ्यागच्छन्‌ सुराः सर्व तपःफलचिक्ीर्षवः`

verses.sloka: ततः स राजा जनकः सचिवान् व्यादिदेश ह ।धनुर् आनीयताम् दिव्यम् गन्ध माल्य अनुलेपितम् ॥१-६७-२॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa rājā janakaḥ sacivān vyādideśa ha ।dhanur ānīyatām divyam gandha mālya anulepitam ॥1-67-2॥

translations.english: Thereafter king Janaka said to his feudatories, "Let the divine bow adorned with flowers and sandalpaste be brought".

verses.sloka: जनकेन समादिष्ठाः सचिवाः प्राविशन् पुरम् ।तत् धनुः पुरतः कृत्वा निर्जग्मुः अमित औजसः ॥१-६७-३॥
verses.transliteration: janakena samādiṣṭhāḥ sacivāḥ prāviśan puram ।tat dhanuḥ purataḥ kṛtvā nirjagmuḥ amita aujasaḥ ॥1-67-3॥

translations.english: Commanded by (king) Janaka, the ministers went to the city, put the bow in front of them and carried it as per the orders of the king.

verses.sloka: नृणाम् शतानि पंचाशत् व्यायतानाम् महात्मनाम् ।मंजूषाम् अष्ट चक्राम् ताम् समूहुः ते कथंचन ॥१-६७-४॥
verses.transliteration: nṛṇām śatāni paṁcāśat vyāyatānām mahātmanām ।maṁjūṣām aṣṭa cakrām tām samūhuḥ te kathaṁcana ॥1-67-4॥

translations.english: Five thousand mighty stalwarts drew with great difficulty the eightwheeled cart on which the bow was placed in a box.

verses.sloka: ताम् आदाय तु मंजूषाम् आयसीम् यत्र तत् धनुः ।सुरोपमम् ते जनकम् ऊचुः नृपति मन्त्रिणः ॥१-६७-५॥
verses.transliteration: tām ādāya tu maṁjūṣām āyasīm yatra tat dhanuḥ ।suropamam te janakam ūcuḥ nṛpati mantriṇaḥ ॥1-67-5॥

translations.english: The counsellors of the king, brought the iron casket containing the bow and said these words to Janaka comparable to a celestial:

verses.sloka: इदम् धनुर् वरम् राजन् पूजितम् सर्व राजभिः ।मिथिला अधिप राज इन्द्र दर्शनीयम् यत् इच्छसि ॥१-६७-६॥
verses.transliteration: idam dhanur varam rājan pūjitam sarva rājabhiḥ ।mithilā adhipa rāja indra darśanīyam yat icchasi ॥1-67-6॥

translations.english: 'O Indra among kings O lord of Mithila here is the great bow, worshipped by all kings, which you intend to show (to Rama)'.

verses.sloka: तेषाम् नृपो वचः श्रुत्वा कृत अंजलिः अभाषत ।विश्वामित्रम् महात्मानम् तौ उभौ राम लक्ष्मणौ ॥१-६७-७॥
verses.transliteration: teṣām nṛpo vacaḥ śrutvā kṛta aṁjaliḥ abhāṣata ।viśvāmitram mahātmānam tau ubhau rāma lakṣmaṇau ॥1-67-7॥

translations.english: Having heard this, the king with folded hands said to the great soul Viswamitra sitting with the two princes Rama and Lakshmana:

verses.sloka: इदम् धनुर् वरम् ब्रह्मन् जनकैः अभिपूजितम् ।राजभिः च महा वीर्यैः अशक्तैः पूरितम् तदा ॥१-६७-८॥
verses.transliteration: idam dhanur varam brahman janakaiḥ abhipūjitam ।rājabhiḥ ca mahā vīryaiḥ aśaktaiḥ pūritam tadā ॥1-67-8॥

translations.english: "O Brahman in the olden days, this great bow was worshipped by my forefathers. Powerful kings failed to string this bow.

verses.sloka: न एतत् सुर गणाः सर्वे स असुरा न च राक्षसाः ।गंधर्व यक्ष प्रवराः स किन्नर महोरगाः ॥१-६७-९॥
verses.transliteration: na etat sura gaṇāḥ sarve sa asurā na ca rākṣasāḥ ।gaṁdharva yakṣa pravarāḥ sa kinnara mahoragāḥ ॥1-67-9॥

translations.english: Hosts of devatas, asuras, rakhasas, kinnaras and great serpents, the best of gandharvas and yakshas, also failed (to wield this bow).
translations.hindi: विश्वामित्र जी को तप करते हुए जब पूरे एक हजार वर्ष चीत गए, (अथवा जब उनका पुरश्चरण पूरा हुआ ), तव सब देवता उनको उनकै तप का फल स्वरूप वर देने की इच्छा से आए

verses.sloka: क्व गतिः मानुषाणाम् च धनुषो अस्य प्रपूरणे ।आरोपणे समायोगे वेपने तोलने अपि वा ॥१-६७-१०॥
verses.transliteration: kva gatiḥ mānuṣāṇām ca dhanuṣo asya prapūraṇe ।āropaṇe samāyoge vepane tolane api vā ॥1-67-10॥

translations.english: How then can men bend, string, fix the arrow, pull the string and lift it?

verses.sloka: तत् एतत् धनुषाम् श्रेष्ठम् आनीतम् मुनिपुंगव ।दर्शय एतत् महाभाग अनयोः राज पुत्रयोः ॥१-६७-११॥
verses.transliteration: tat etat dhanuṣām śreṣṭham ānītam munipuṁgava ।darśaya etat mahābhāga anayoḥ rāja putrayoḥ ॥1-67-11॥

translations.english: O Eminent ascetic such heaviest bow is brought here, O Highly accomplished sage show this to the two princes".

verses.sloka: विश्वामित्रः स रामः तु श्रुत्वा जनक भाषितम् ।वत्स राम धनुः पश्य इति राघवम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-६७-१२॥
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitraḥ sa rāmaḥ tu śrutvā janaka bhāṣitam ।vatsa rāma dhanuḥ paśya iti rāghavam abravīt ॥1-67-12॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of Janaka, the righteous Viswamitra said: "O Child O Descendant of Raghu look at this bow".

verses.sloka: महर्षेः वचनात् रामो यत्र तिष्ठति तत् धनुः ।मंजूषाम् ताम् अपावृत्य दृष्ट्वा धनुः अथ अब्रवीत् ॥१-६७-१३॥
verses.transliteration: maharṣeḥ vacanāt rāmo yatra tiṣṭhati tat dhanuḥ ।maṁjūṣām tām apāvṛtya dṛṣṭvā dhanuḥ atha abravīt ॥1-67-13॥

translations.english: At the words of the great rishi Viswamitra, Rama opened the casket, beheld the bow and said:

verses.sloka: इदम् धनुर्वरम् ब्रह्मन् संस्पृशामि इह पाणिना ।यत्नवान् च भविष्यामि तोलने पूरणे अपि वा ॥१-६७-१४॥
verses.transliteration: idam dhanurvaram brahman saṁspṛśāmi iha pāṇinā ।yatnavān ca bhaviṣyāmi tolane pūraṇe api vā ॥1-67-14॥

translations.english: "O Brahmarshi, shall I touch this great bow with my hands lift and string it".

verses.sloka: बाढम् इति एव तम् राजा मुनिः च समभाषत ।लीलया स धनुर् मध्ये जग्राह वचनात् मुनेः ॥१-६७-१५॥
verses.transliteration: bāḍham iti eva tam rājā muniḥ ca samabhāṣata ।līlayā sa dhanur madhye jagrāha vacanāt muneḥ ॥1-67-15॥

translations.english: The king as also the rishi said "Be it so". At the words of the sage (Viswamitra), he (Rama) took hold of the bow by the its middle with ease:

verses.sloka: पश्यताम् नृ सहस्राणाम् बहूनाम् रघुनंदनः ।आरोपयत् स धर्मात्मा स लीलम् इव तत् धनुः ॥१-६७-१६॥
verses.transliteration: paśyatām nṛ sahasrāṇām bahūnām raghunaṁdanaḥ ।āropayat sa dharmātmā sa līlam iva tat dhanuḥ ॥1-67-16॥

translations.english: Virtuous Rama, the delight of the Raghus, in the presence of several thousands of men fixed the string to the bow and drew it as though with ease.

verses.sloka: आरोपयित्वा मौर्वीम् च पूरयामास वीर्यवान् ।तत् बभंज धनुर् मध्ये नरश्रेष्ठो महायशाः ॥१-६७-१७॥
verses.transliteration: āropayitvā maurvīm ca pūrayāmāsa vīryavān ।tat babhaṁja dhanur madhye naraśreṣṭho mahāyaśāḥ ॥1-67-17॥

translations.english: Rama, the best among men, righteous and famous lifted the bow. Stringing it with a twang he drew it and broke it into two in the middle.

verses.sloka: तस्य शब्दो महान् आसीत् निर्घात सम निःस्वनः ।भूमि कंपः च सुमहान् पर्वतस्य इव दीर्यतः ॥१-६७-१८॥
verses.transliteration: tasya śabdo mahān āsīt nirghāta sama niḥsvanaḥ ।bhūmi kaṁpaḥ ca sumahān parvatasya iva dīryataḥ ॥1-67-18॥

translations.english: It generated a loud sound like the clap of thunder, like the trembling of the earth and the splitting of a mountain.

verses.sloka: निपेतुः च नराः सर्वे तेन शब्देन मोहिताः ।व्रजयित्वा मुनि वरम् राजानम् तौ च राघवौ ॥१-६७-१९॥
verses.transliteration: nipetuḥ ca narāḥ sarve tena śabdena mohitāḥ ।vrajayitvā muni varam rājānam tau ca rāghavau ॥1-67-19॥

translations.english: On hearing the sound, except Janaka, Viswamitra and the two raghavas (Rama and Lakshmana) the rest of the people around fell down and fainted.

verses.sloka: प्रति आश्वस्तो जने तस्मिन् राजा विगत साध्वसः ।उवाच प्रांजलिः वाक्यम् वाक्यज्ञो मुनिपुंगवम् ॥१-६७-२०॥
verses.transliteration: prati āśvasto jane tasmin rājā vigata sādhvasaḥ ।uvāca prāṁjaliḥ vākyam vākyajño munipuṁgavam ॥1-67-20॥

translations.english: When the people recovered the king skilful in the use of words addressed the eminent ascetic without apprehension with folded palms in the following words:

verses.sloka: भगवन् दृष्ट वीर्यो मे रामो दशरथ आत्मजः ।अति अद्भुतम् अचिंत्यम् च अतर्कितम् इदम् मया ॥१-६७-२१॥
verses.transliteration: bhagavan dṛṣṭa vīryo me rāmo daśaratha ātmajaḥ ।ati adbhutam aciṁtyam ca atarkitam idam mayā ॥1-67-21॥

translations.english: "O Worshipful one I have witnessed the prowess of Rama, son of Dasaratha. I had not imagined that this marvellous feat could be ever accomplished.

verses.sloka: जनकानाम् कुले कीर्तिम् आहरिष्यति मे सुता ।सीता भर्तारम् आसाद्य रामम् दशरथ आत्मजम् ॥१-६७-२२॥
verses.transliteration: janakānām kule kīrtim āhariṣyati me sutā ।sītā bhartāram āsādya rāmam daśaratha ātmajam ॥1-67-22॥

translations.english: By receiving Rama, son of Dasaratha, as her husband, my daughter Sita will bring glory to my dynasty.

verses.sloka: मम सत्या प्रतिज्ञा सा वीर्य शुल्का इति कौशिक ।सीता प्राणैः बहुमता देया रामाय मे सुता ॥१-६७-२३॥
verses.transliteration: mama satyā pratijñā sā vīrya śulkā iti kauśika ।sītā prāṇaiḥ bahumatā deyā rāmāya me sutā ॥1-67-23॥

translations.english: O Son of Kausika I announce Sita to be the 'Reward of prowess'. My vow has come true. She is more valuable than my life and fit to be given to Rama.

verses.sloka: भवतो अनुमते ब्रह्मन् शीघ्रम् गच्छंतु मंत्रिणः ।मम कौशिक भद्रम् ते अयोध्याम् त्वरिता रथैः ॥१-६७-२४॥
verses.transliteration: bhavato anumate brahman śīghram gacchaṁtu maṁtriṇaḥ ।mama kauśika bhadram te ayodhyām tvaritā rathaiḥ ॥1-67-24॥

translations.english: O Brahmarshi Kausika, be blessed With your consent my ministers will take the chariots to Ayodhya immediately.

verses.sloka: राजानम् प्रश्रितैः वाक्यैः आनयंतु पुरम् मम ।प्रदानम् वीर्य शुक्लायाः कथयंतु च सर्वशः ॥१-६७-२५॥
verses.transliteration: rājānam praśritaiḥ vākyaiḥ ānayaṁtu puram mama ।pradānam vīrya śuklāyāḥ kathayaṁtu ca sarvaśaḥ ॥1-67-25॥

translations.english: That Sita, the reward of prowess is to be given to Rama be reventially communicated in detail to king Dasaratha and he may be conveyed here.

verses.sloka: मुनि गुप्तौ च काकुत्स्थौ कथयंतु नृपाय वै ।प्रीति युक्तम् तु राजानम् आनयंतु सु शीघ्र गाः ॥१-६७-२६॥
verses.transliteration: muni guptau ca kākutsthau kathayaṁtu nṛpāya vai ।prīti yuktam tu rājānam ānayaṁtu su śīghra gāḥ ॥1-67-26॥

translations.english: The welfare of the descendant of Kausika (Rama and Lakshmana) under the protection of sage (Viswamitra) be reported to the king. The king who will be happy to hear this be brought here by swiftfooted men".

verses.sloka: कौशिकः च तथा इति आह राजा च आभाष्य मंत्रिणः ।अयोध्याम् प्रेषयामास धर्मात्मा कृत शासनान् ।यथा वृत्तम् समाख्यातुम् आनेतुम् च नृपम् तथा ॥१-६७-२७॥
verses.transliteration: kauśikaḥ ca tathā iti āha rājā ca ābhāṣya maṁtriṇaḥ ।ayodhyām preṣayāmāsa dharmātmā kṛta śāsanān ।yathā vṛttam samākhyātum ānetum ca nṛpam tathā ॥1-67-27॥

translations.english: The son of Kausika (Viswamitra) also said, "So be it". The virtuous king, having consulted his ministers, despatched counsellors to Ayodhya to communicate to king Dasaratha all that had taken place and bring him (to Mithila). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे सप्तषष्टितमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the sixtyseventh sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
